bullets.title: AMD: Citi Buy/$575 PT — Data Center to 2x in 2027, MI450 ramp this quarter
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy on AMD with $575 PT (16.5% upside) following Citi TMT conference. MI450 GPU launches this quarter with significant Q4 ramp; data center business expected to more than double in 2027. Server CPU TAM revised to $220B by 2030 (from $25B in 2025) as agentic AI represents >50% of TAM; enterprise server grew 70% in 2Q26. AMD targeting 50% server CPU share ($100B business); Helios ramp exceeding expectations with all 3 anchor customers (Meta + 2 AI labs) increasing forecasts.

bullets.title: AMAT: Citi Buy/$710 PT — Advanced Packaging +70%, services +20%, confident on CY27
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy on AMAT with $710 PT (56% upside). Advanced packaging grows >70% in CY26 from $1.4B base; DRAM greenfield adding ~400K wspm annually. Services running >20% growth in CY26; PDC (process control) up >50% on 3D/e-beam demand. AMAT investing to support ~2x current quarterly systems output by 2028; 100+ fabs tracked globally with rising utilization across all nodes.

bullets.title: NVDA/AVGO: AI infrastructure demand robust — 70K NVL racks, TPUs doubling, $1.3T CSP capex ahead
bullets.body: Oppenheimer Asia checks show NVL rack volumes tracking ~70K in 2026 (vs ~50K prior); TPU units doubling to 7-8M next year. Wafer/CoWoS allocation increasingly favors NVDA and AVGO as a 'competitive weapon.' VR200 rack ASP ~$8M (2x GB300); advanced packaging supply stretched up to 9 months. Morgan Stanley flags NVDA +30% upside (PT $300) on Blackwell demand with revenues +88% '26e, +70% '27e; AVGO pointing to 100%+ growth in '27-'28.

bullets.title: Hyperscalers (AMZN/META/GOOGL/MSFT): MS flags 'Age of Inference' rotation into quality; all four OW
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley Nowak upgrades AI cycle narrative to 'Age of Inference,' favoring hyperscalers as capex growth decelerates post-2027. META OW PT $775 (+26%) on AI ad uplift and highest ROIC (~46%); MSFT OW PT $600 (+20%) at ~20x FY28 GAAP EPS; AMZN OW PT $335 (+30%) on AWS growth of 40.8% in '27e; GOOGL OW PT $400 (+18%) on AI Mode surpassing 1B MAUs. Hyperscalers generate $980B-$1.2T OCF in '27/'28 vs only ~$290B debt needed.

bullets.title: GLW: Citi Buy/$220 PT — Multi-billion Verizon fiber deal through 2032 is major catalyst
bullets.body: Corning and Verizon signed a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar supply agreement for 80M+ miles of high-density optical fiber from 2027-2032, supporting broadband expansion to 40-50M passings and AI hyperscaler backbone. Citi initiates/maintains Buy at $220 PT (43% upside) applying 32x P/E to CY28 EPS. GLW pre-market +2.9% on the announcement.

bullets.title: NVDA: Acquires Hugging Face for $12.9B; Mediatek deal noted; private AI ecosystem investments
bullets.body: NVIDIA confirmed agreement to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B including $1B retention package (announced Sept 3). UBS notes NVDA also has a deal with Mediatek. NVDA-backed Firmus Technologies preparing ASX IPO with 900MW+ capacity from Malaysian data centers signed with OpenAI. NVDA investor in Ipronics ($125M Series B for AI data center networking) and Superluminal Medicines ($60M Series B).

bullets.title: SHOP: Down ~8.7% in Canada trading on TSX; software sector broadly weak pre-market
bullets.body: Shopify trading down 8.7% (C$183.31) on TSX mid-morning. Pre-market U.S. tape also shows SHOP -2.2%, alongside TEAM -2.3%, WDAY -1.9%, NOW -1.8%, and TWLO -2.1% as enterprise software names face broad selling pressure on rising yields (10-yr +2bps to 4.76%).

bullets.title: INTC: Pre-market +4.6% on Northland upgrade; CPU prices set to rise another 10%
bullets.body: Intel surged 4.6% pre-market following a Northland Capital Markets upgrade citing DigiTimes reports of PC CPU prices set to rise another 10%. Semiconductor sector broadly outperforming on OpenAI Astra (GPT-6) release tailwind.

bullets.title: HOOD: +3.4% pre-market — OG.com prediction market partnership + Crypto.com expansion
bullets.body: Robinhood selected OG.com as infrastructure partner for its prediction markets platform, driving +3.4% pre-market gain. Separately, Robinhood is partnering with Crypto.com to expand prediction markets. KeyBanc notes HOOD will charge $0.50/contract pro options fee effective Oct 15. JPM flags HOOD-Crypto.com as a 'major growth driver.'

bullets.title: U (Unity): Citi Buy/$48 PT, Jefferies Buy/$50 PT — Vector >$1B, D28 gaining traction
bullets.body: Multiple banks constructive post-Citi TMT conference: Citi Buy $48 PT (17.3% upside, 28x 2027 FCF), Jefferies Buy $50 PT. Vector recently crossed $1B revenue; 28-day ROAS product newly launched and gaining traction. Runtime data opt-in rate >90% from Unity 6.3+ games seen as next inflection. Management targeting incremental gross margins above 80%; dismisses AI-generated games as near-term competitive threat.

bullets.title: NXST: Citi Buy/$215 PT — TEGNA oral arguments Nov 17; political ad spend 'ripping'
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy on NXST at $215 PT (6x EV/EBITDA on avg 2027-28 EBITDA). TEGNA Ninth Circuit oral arguments confirmed for Nov 17, 2026 with full trial July 2027 — seen as near-term catalyst. Political advertising described as starting earlier than historical pattern and 'ripping.' CW expected to reach profitability this year; EdgeBeam Wireless JV covers 97% of US with ~7B MHz-pops of spectrum.

bullets.title: NWSA: JPM NDR Sept 23; management bullish on Dow Jones $1B EBITDA target and AI monetization
bullets.body: JPM hosting NWSA non-deal roadshow Sept 23 in NYC. At Citi TMT, management targets Dow Jones EBITDA of $1B by 2030 led by B2B risk/compliance and energy businesses; three consecutive years of mid-teens EBITDA growth. AI viewed as net positive with content licensing deals already monetizing. Accelerated buybacks reflect management's view stock trades at significant discount to intrinsic value.

bullets.title: ACN: UBS Buy/$275 PT — Gemini Enterprise unit with 1,000 FDEs could add 250-300bps annual growth
bullets.body: UBS maintains Buy on Accenture at $275 PT (~16x 2028E EPS). Accenture and Google Cloud launched Gemini Enterprise Business Group with 1,000 forward-deployed engineers. Gen AI-associated revenue could contribute ~250-300bps annual growth as clients move from pilot to production. ACN has 50K Google Cloud-skilled professionals.

bullets.title: CRDO: Jefferies NDR Sept 29, Buy/$270 PT; pullback attributed to soft implied AEC growth in H2
bullets.body: Jefferies hosting CRDO non-deal roadshow Sept 29 NYC; analyst Blayne Curtis maintains Buy at $270 PT. JPM hardware note flags CRDO pullback driven by decision not to raise FY optical revenue guidance, implying soft AEC growth in H2 fiscal year. CRDO ranked among the top AI interconnect beneficiaries for AI data infrastructure.

bullets.title: AMZN: Qualcomm multi-gen AI chip collaboration; warrant for 25M shares at $161.26
bullets.body: Qualcomm issued a warrant to Amazon for up to 25M shares at $161.26/sh (expires 2036), tied to up to $60B in Amazon purchases, as part of a multi-generation custom AI inference silicon collaboration for large-scale data centers. Companies also developing optical connectivity up to 1.6T capacity and Qualcomm expanding EDA workloads on Amazon Bedrock.

bullets.title: CRM/META/SHOP: AI agent adoption signals — Slack wins Meta, Shopify benefits from Anthropic commerce agents
bullets.body: Meta replacing Google Chat with Slack, citing it as strongest platform for agents; Salesforce Slack reported fastest net new AOV growth since acquisition, Slackbot surpassed 1M active users (+150% q/q). Anthropic commerce agents on Claude show 35% larger carts and 60% higher purchase completion rates, with Shopify building reference storefront on the blueprints. ChatGPT Ads surpassed $1B annualized revenue in under 200 days.

bullets.title: CVNA/BKNG: Morgan Stanley reiterates as non-AI high-conviction best ideas
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's broadening webcast reiterates CVNA Overweight at $90 PT (near-term reset for long-term flywheel) and BKNG as strong execution play through volatile macro with AI call options. Both highlighted as idiosyncratic earnings drivers independent of AI cycle.

bullets.title: RH: Q2 earnings preview — $915M revenue consensus, 14% implied move, 32% short interest
bullets.body: RH Q2 consensus at $915M revenue (+1.8% YoY) and $0.38 EPS; EBITDA margin guided 11.5-13.0% vs consensus 12.8%. Options imply ~14.1% post-earnings move. Short interest elevated at 32%. FY revenue guidance $3.59-3.71B. Stock +9% since June 11 vs S&P +4%.

bullets.title: ENPH: SST power module manufacturing underway; full demo Nov, derisking data center entry
bullets.body: Enphase has begun manufacturing power modules for its solid state transformer (SST) targeting data centers, with full system demonstration planned for November 2026 and 2027 pilot programs. OpCo flags this as derisking data center market entry ahead of key competitors, supporting upside scenarios to Street estimates.

bullets.title: Short interest / positioning: AVGO largest notional short (55M shares +122% WoW); MRVL SI up 36%
bullets.body: UBS short book shows US tech net short +1% WoW. AVGO holds largest notional short at 55.2M shares (+122% WoW); SNOW second at 14.0M shares (+42.8% WoW); MRVL up 36.2% to 38.7M shares; DELL up 26.9%. Covering activity in MU (-25.3%) and TXN (-33.4%). Morgan Stanley QDS notes HF net positioning to long Quality only in 14th percentile, indicating room to grow; rotation out of semis/hardware into hyperscalers at fastest clip since Liberation Day (mid-2025).
